import json, random
rng = random.Random(7)
P, R, D = 8, 128, 32
inputs = [[[rng.randint(-10**9,10**9) for _ in range(D)] for _ in range(R)] for _ in range(P)]
events = []
ids = []
for i in range(20000):
    k = rng.random()
    if k < 0.3:
        events.append(["send", rng.randrange(P), rng.randrange(R)])
    elif k < 0.4:
        events.append(["retry", rng.randrange(P)])
    else:
        events.append([rng.choice(["deliver","drop","duplicate"]), rng.randrange(0, 3000)])
req = {"op":"replay","inputs":inputs,"slots":16,"window":16,"events":events}
line = json.dumps(req)
print("line bytes:", len(line))
open("maxrep.jsonl","w").write(line+"\n")
PYEOF
time python3 -I /app/submission/main.py < maxrep.jsonl | wc -c
